entries.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals: a 75-second looping MENU theme for a Tron-style neon arena. Slow and wide, cold glassy synth pads, a deep sub pulse, sparse arpeggios entering after 8 seconds, restrained percussion after 16 seconds, no big climax, ending that loops cleanly to the start.

Instrumental only, no vocals: a 90-second looping COMBAT theme for a neon tank arena at 130 BPM. Driving analog bass ostinato, tight electronic percussion, a cold lead motif, a breakdown around 45 seconds, then rebuild, ends cleanly for a seamless loop.
The sound of a tank exploding into digital shards: a deep concussive boom with an electric crack and a long shard-fall tail, no music, no voice.
The sound of an energy shell striking a tank hull: a sharp metallic clang with a short electronic sizzle, very short, no music, no voice.
The sound of an energy cannon recharging: a rising electrical whine that locks with a solid clunk at the end, no music, no voice.
The sound of a Tron interface control being pressed: a short bright electronic chirp with a tiny echo, no music, no voice.
The sound of a short victory sting in a Tron arena: a rising synthetic chord with shimmer, three seconds, no voice.
The sound of a short defeat sting in a Tron arena: a descending detuned synthetic tone with a low electric rumble, three seconds, no voice.
The sound of a heavy energy cannon firing in a cavernous neon arena: a deep electric thump with crackling discharge and a short metallic tail, no music, no voice.
The sound of a glowing wall panel shattering into metallic shards: sharp electronic glass crack, tumbling debris, short tail, no music, no voice.
The sound of an energy grid regenerating: rising electrical hum with a glassy shimmer and a soft locking pulse at the end, no music, no voice.
